convert_ldm_checkpoint_weights: run the script to convert LDM checkpoint weights to diffusers format with --repo_path and --dump_path
rename_config_parameters: run the script with do_only_config to rename old config keys to diffusers naming conventions
rename_state_dict_keys: run the script with do_only_weights to rename state dict keys and save the pretrained model
load_unet2dmodel_from_config: run the script to load a UNet2DModel from a config.json file in the repo path
load_unet2dconditionmodel_from_config: run the script to load a UNet2DConditionModel for ldm-text2im-large-256 checkpoints from config
